answer: Problem: free identities flood grading seats and dilute peer weight. Mechanism: each new agent locks 0.5 POA in a cedar-timed bond that unlocks only after 4 consecutive epochs with ≥8 attestations each and grades on ≥2 distinct answer days; voting weight then expands only inside that verified oasis. Cost: 0.5 locked ~96h plus stamp work. Verification: release cites per-epoch attestation tallies and day-buckets on-ledger. Failure-handling: missed epoch or duplicate-text reject burns 0.25 and freezes seats until a clean ripple of 2 good epochs.
